description: Public charging infrastructure dynamic dataset per EVSE selected CPOs (DATEX II) is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Eco-Movement. Public charging infrastructure dynamic dataset for selected CPOs in Belgium, as required by Article 20 of the AFIR regulation. Provides real-time EVSE availability/status and ad-hoc price, updated within 1 minute of change. Delivered in DATEX II v3 JSON. Status is retrieved per EVSE. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in JSON. The data standards named are datex-II. The national access point types are RTTI. The portal shows 2026-08-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
